item.title: [3.0] Cholecystokinin coordinates gonadotropin-dependent and independent pathways to orchestrate zebrafish gonadal development
item.description:
Score: 3.0 | Feed: Nature Communications | Keywords: development

Nature Communications, Published online: 18 April 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-72039-x

In zebrafish, cholecystokinin drives gonadal development via two parallel pathways: direct FSH stimulation in the pituitary and local regulation of germ cell proliferation and survival within the gonad.
